[DQC.US.0220.10748] The filing has used the StatementTable in the notes in the role 9955566 - Disclosure - Revenue Recognition In-Scope and Out-of-Scope Revenue Streams (Details). The StatementTable is not intended to be used in the notes, it is intended to be used in the face financial statements. The filer should use the appropriate table name for the notes disclosure. If no table is appropriate for the note disclosure, the filer should create an extension table with a name that describes the information in the table.

Rule Element Id:10748
Rule version: 30.0.5 - fcf-20260331.htm 8

[DQC.US.0230.10923] The calculation network 9952153 - Statement - Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income (Unaudited) has used the 'other' concept InterestExpenseOtherLongTermDebt.  The calculation relationship has a calculation concept total of  InterestExpense.  The 'other' concept in this calculation is expected to be only InterestExpenseOther. Each calculated concept should only have 'other' concepts that can comprise it.

Replace the other concept InterestExpenseOtherLongTermDebt with InterestExpenseOther.
   
Rule Element Id:10923
Rule version: 30.0.5 - https://xbrl.fasb.org/us-gaap/

[DQC.US.0238.10937] The filer has used the table text block ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock in the filing, but has not reported any facts with the StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis. A segment member is required to be reported with the StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis even if there is only one reportable segment. (see FASB Taxonomy Implementation guide at https://www.fasb.org/projects/fasb-taxonomies/resources/taxonomy-implementation-guides ) The filer should report facts with the StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis if using the ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock
